definitions.explanation: The state of being strong, active, and full of energy.

examples.japanese: {活力|かつりょく}に{満|み}ちている。
{経済|けいざい}に{活力|かつりょく}を{与|あた}える。
examples.english: To give energy to the economy.

examples.japanese: {活力|かつりょく}を{取|と}り{戻|もど}す。

notes:
{活力|かつりょく} means vitality, energy, or vigor.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
{活|かつ} (life, active) + {力|りょく} (power)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {活力|かつりょく}に{満|み}ちた: full of vitality
- {活力|かつりょく}がある: to have energy
- {活力|かつりょく}を{失|うしな}う: to lose vitality
- {活力|かつりょく}を{取|と}り{戻|もど}す: to regain vitality
- {活力|かつりょく}を{与|あた}える: to give energy

USAGE CONTEXTS:
- Personal health/energy
- Economic vitality ({経済|けいざい}に{活力|かつりょく}を)
- Organizational energy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {元気|げんき}: health, cheerfulness (casual)
- {精力|せいりょく}: energy, stamina
- {気力|きりょく}: willpower, spirit
